meta.title: How I treat myself (FSCRS)
meta.subtitle: Three voices you answer yourself with when things go wrong.
meta.description: Twenty-two statements about how you relate to yourself when things go wrong for you. The score is three means from 0 to 4: inadequate self (feeling you fall short), hated self (disgust and the wish to punish yourself) and reassured self (the ability to encourage yourself). Forms of Self-Criticising/Attacking and Self-Reassuring Scale (Gilbert, Clarke, Hempel, Miles & Irons, 2004), made freely available by the Compassionate Mind Foundation with attribution.
meta.disclaimer: This tool supports self-reflection and tracking change. It does not diagnose and does not replace a consultation with a professional. If thoughts of hurting yourself are frequent or strong, talk to someone you trust or to a professional.

consent.title: Consent and disclaimer
consent.body: I understand this is a self-reflection tool, not a clinical test, and I agree to store my results locally on this device.

interpretation.low: This voice speaks up rarely for you.
interpretation.medium: This voice speaks up moderately often for you.
interpretation.high: This voice speaks up often for you.

items.fscrs_01: I am easily disappointed with myself.
items.fscrs_02: There is a part of me that puts me down.
items.fscrs_03: I am able to remind myself of positive things about myself.
items.fscrs_04: I find it difficult to control my anger and frustration at myself.
items.fscrs_05: I find it easy to forgive myself.

fscrs_06.m: There is a part of me that feels I am not good enough.
fscrs_06.f: There is a part of me that feels I am not good enough.

fscrs_07.m: I feel beaten down by my own self-critical thoughts.
fscrs_07.f: I feel beaten down by my own self-critical thoughts.

fscrs_09.m: I have become so angry with myself that I want to hurt or injure myself.
fscrs_09.f: I have become so angry with myself that I want to hurt or injure myself.

items.fscrs_10: I have a sense of disgust with myself.
items.fscrs_11: I can still feel lovable and acceptable.
items.fscrs_13: I find it easy to like myself.
items.fscrs_14: I remember and dwell on my failings.

fscrs_16.m: I am gentle and supportive with myself.
fscrs_16.f: I am gentle and supportive with myself.

items.fscrs_17: I can't accept failures and setbacks without feeling inadequate.
items.fscrs_18: I think I deserve my self-criticism.
items.fscrs_19: I am able to care and look after myself.
items.fscrs_20: There is a part of me that wants to get rid of the bits I don't like.
items.fscrs_21: I encourage myself for the future.
items.fscrs_22: I do not like being me.
